items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add treats to your cart, fill in your delivery details and tap "Place order on WhatsApp". WhatsApp opens with your full order ready — just press send. Hema will reply to confirm.
Dream Kitchen is pre-booking only. Every order is dispatched after {days} business days (Monday to Saturday), so everything is made fresh for you.
We don't take payments on the website. After Hema confirms your order on WhatsApp, she will share UPI details. Your order is prepared once payment is received.

items.q: Where do you deliver and how much does it cost?
items.a: We deliver all over Karnataka for a flat ₹{charge}. Pincodes starting with 56, 57, 58 or 59 are accepted.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my order?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp as soon as possible. Since everything is made fresh, changes are possible until preparation starts.
